scripts.ios-mode: npm run copy-ios-config && echo ✅ Configuración iOS activada
scripts.android-mode: npm run copy-android-config && echo 🤖 Configuración Android activada
scripts.copy-ios-config: copy pubspec_ios.yaml pubspec.yaml && copy main_ios.dart lib\main.dart
scripts.copy-android-config: copy pubspec_android.yaml pubspec.yaml && copy main_android.dart lib\main.dart
scripts.build-ios: npm run ios-mode && flutter clean && flutter pub get && flutter build ios --release
scripts.build-android: npm run android-mode && flutter clean && flutter pub get && flutter build apk --release
